hero.subtitle: One design and build studio for marble and stone, flooring, turnkey construction and interior design.

approach.title: MATERIAL FIRST
approach.text: Every project begins with the stone or the surface. Specification precedes drawings so the material never has to bend to fit the design.

approach.title: ONE TEAM
approach.text: Materials, flooring, construction and interiors under one roof. One accountable team from the spec sheet to the snag list.

approach.title: EDITORIAL DETAIL
approach.text: Architectural minimalism, hospitality warmth. Joints, thresholds and reveals resolved with the same care as the elevation.

approach.title: HERITAGE + CRAFT
approach.text: Traditional cutting and finishing techniques paired with modern engineering. Craftspeople we have worked with for two decades.

approach.title: EXPERIENCE-LED
approach.text: Don't just see the materials — live in them. The BDSM Living Studio is our showroom you can actually stay in.

divisions.name: MARBLE & STONE
divisions.tagline: Stone that carries the building's silhouette.
divisions.body: Facade and face stone for structures that need to age well. Interior stone — tables, fountains, decorative work — cut and finished in our own workshops.

divisions.name: FLOORING
divisions.tagline: Flooring, specified for how a space is actually lived in.
divisions.body: Residential, hospitality and commercial projects — a distributed range and a proprietary line built for high-traffic floors.

divisions.name: CONSTRUCTION
divisions.tagline: Buildings built the way the material wants to be used.
divisions.body: Foundation, structure, finishes and site management for residential, hospitality and commercial builds — with a material-first sensibility.

divisions.name: INTERIOR DESIGNING
divisions.tagline: Design that decides before the build begins.
divisions.body: Concept, spatial planning, material palettes and detailing — resolved with our own stone, flooring and construction teams before a single wall is touched.

about.lede_1: BDSM · BDS Marvel is one design and build company — stone, flooring, construction and interiors, handled in-house by our own teams: Drawstones, Renest, Formwork and Vignette. One contract, one accountable team, from facade to floor to furniture.
about.lede_2: The names are new — our people have built for the country's most demanding hotels, developers and civic projects for over twenty years.

living_studio.name: Air BnB Living Studio
living_studio.tagline: Not a showroom — a home we built ourselves.
living_studio.body: A guesthouse we built ourselves — our own stone, flooring, finishes and furniture throughout. Stay the night, live with every surface and plan your project from inside a working home.
